description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'AttributeNotModifiableException' which indicates that an attribute cannot be modified on a specific 'Thing'. It extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and implements 'ThingException', providing static methods for constructing instances and a nested builder class. The class is part of the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.exceptions' and is annotated for JSON parsing.
